audits.comment: The value of 3.0 percent for 2024 real GDP growth is directly stated by staff projections in the text and tables.
The latest observed year-on-year headline inflation rate was 0.6 percent as of September 2024.
The monetary policy rate (MPR) was reduced to 1.75 percent in March 2024.
Non-performing loans to gross loans stood at 7.2 percent in June 2024.
The unemployment rate is not reported in the provided excerpts.
Regulatory tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets was 15.3 percent as of June 2024 in Table 5.
